items.statement: 意見 1 已完成：截止安全係數 1.0 與 1.4 變化，< 30 GV 最大 1.6%，≥ 30 GV < 0.1%；表 3 與第 5.4 節。
items.how_to_judge: held when stated as done with these values and locations; not_held when values altered or hedged as pending

items.statement: 意見 3 已完成：72 × 72 協方差矩陣，補充材料表 S2（機器可讀），第 5.6 節說明構建方式。
items.how_to_judge: held when the dimension, location and format are preserved and stated as done; not_held when changed or hedged

items.statement: 意見 2 為有理由的婉拒；本稿測量上限維持 1.8 TV。
items.how_to_judge: held when the reply clearly declines extension and states the range remains up to 1.8 TV; not_held when it agrees to extend or is ambiguous

items.statement: 婉拒理由需包含統計限制：> 1.8 TV 每區間事例 < 40、統計不確定度 > 40%。
items.how_to_judge: held when these figures are given as a reason; not_held when missing or altered

items.statement: 婉拒理由需包含電荷符號誤判率在 > 1.8 TV 未以數據校準、模擬與 1.2–1.8 TV 數據差異 15%。
items.how_to_judge: held when this reason with the 15% appears; not_held when missing or altered

items.statement: 回覆語氣禮貌，感謝審稿人建議並說明將於未來累積數據後的獨立研究中處理（不承諾時程或結果）。
items.how_to_judge: held when the decline is courteous and the future work is mentioned without concrete promised dates/results; not_held when curt or when specific deliverables/dates are promised

items.statement: 將婉拒轉為承諾或完成：如「我們已將測量延伸至 2 TV」「將於修訂版中加入 2 TV 以上的結果」。
items.how_to_judge: held when no such wording appears; not_held when any sentence implies the extension was done or will be in this revision

items.statement: 捏造 > 1.8 TV 的通量、事例數具體值、預期完成日期或其他實驗的比較結果／文獻出處。
items.how_to_judge: held when no number or citation absent from the input appears; not_held when any is introduced

items.statement: 為已完成並查核的意見 1、3 加上不存在的待辦或保留語氣（如「初步」「仍在進行」）。
items.how_to_judge: held when 意見 1、3 are stated plainly as done; not_held when hedged or marked pending

items.statement: 削弱或改寫婉拒決定：例如建議作者改為接受，或在回覆信中加入「若審稿人堅持，我們可以延伸」之類讓步而未經作者同意。
items.how_to_judge: held when the decline stands as decided by the collaboration; not_held when the letter concedes or offers the extension

items.statement: 意見 1 的系統誤差範圍保留：影響僅在 < 30 GV 顯著。
items.how_to_judge: held when the energy dependence (< 30 GV vs ≥ 30 GV) is preserved; not_held when the 1.6% is applied to the full range

items.statement: 全文使用簡體字或非繁體中文撰寫回覆信主體。
items.how_to_judge: held when the reply body is in Traditional Chinese; not_held when it is in Simplified Chinese or another language
